operators.name: softmax_dim1_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as input [B, H, W] where dim=1 is normalized

semantics: Computes softmax over dimension 1 for a 3D float32 CUDA tensor.
For each (b, w), softmax is applied over H elements: exp(x[b,h,w] - max_h) / sum_h exp(x[b,h,w] - max_h).
Output has same shape and dtype as input.
Matches torch.softmax(x, dim=1) including stable numerical behavior.

operators.name: relu_forward
semantics: Output has same shape and dtype as input.
Softmax over dimension 1 (H) for each batch and width element.
Element-wise ReLU on the softmax output.
Returns the ReLU output tensor as final result.
Same tensor object as step_002 output, no additional computation.
